title: BLACKOUT
description: CERBERUS controls the power grid. A single signed command can cut a sector. The question is which.
goal: Break into CERBERUS and upload the blackout signature.
hint: CERBERUS needs your Anonymous Credential in the inventory. Upload ~/blackout.sig once logged in.

cerberus_access.txt: requires: anonymous credential in your inventory

messages.text: Signature's in ~/blackout.sig. Pick your sector carefully — you can't un-cut a city.

story_start: ARCHER: "A power cut would blind NEXUS's annex for a few minutes. Minutes are all we need."
MIRA: "Please be careful, {player}. People live in those sectors."

objectives.text: Build a relay route to CERBERUS

objectives.hint: Seven symbols, five slots. Use the feedback.
You need the Anonymous Credential (from GHOST's ledger) in your inventory.

choice.prompt: The console blinks: WHICH SECTOR LOSES POWER?

options.text: SECTOR 9 — the NEXUS annex (93% load, no backup). Maximum damage to NEXUS.
options.result: The NEXUS annex goes dark. Somewhere, a very patient machine notices.

options.text: SECTOR 7 — commercial (backup: partial). A safer, smaller cut.
options.result: Offices and shops fall dark. Nobody gets hurt. Nobody learns anything either.
You pull the signature before it fires. The city never knew how close it was.

story_end: CERBERUS's three heads watch you leave. The third one seems to follow you out.

messages.text: Whatever you did to the grid, NEXUS is furious. Be ready: next stop is the core's outer ring.
